Build, Ride, Empower

We’ve spent many years refining and perfecting our build technique with one clear goal: to make the building experience as accessible as possible to people of all ages and abilities. As an open-source community, we have learned and shared skills with thousands of builders and have been able to pass this on through our workshops and home-build kits.

Why Bamboo?

We started using bamboo to create bikes as it is an interesting engineering material that is underutilized. With over 1,500 species, it can be grown almost anywhere in the world, making it both accessible and sustainable for builders everywhere. It also has many qualities that make it ideal for bicycle construction; it naturally forms aerodynamic tubes in varied diameters, has a high weight-to-strength ratio, and possesses unique vibration-dampening characteristics. Bamboo also has a negative carbon footprint, as it absorbs 30% more CO2 than traditional timber, making it one of the key materials in climate change mitigation. However, bamboo can be difficult to join due to its wall thickness and structure.

Our Community: More Than Just Builders

Our community stretches across the world. We have shipped our kits to 42 different countries and collaborated with communities, creating pop-up workshops in many countries outside of the UK. We have also conducted team-building sessions and talks across Europe. We have an active community on social media with help forums for builders and a Strava ride group.

Innovation at the Core

We invest the majority of our profits into innovation and prototyping. We support university students and research projects. We've worked with tmany universities to better understand how bamboo performs in different environments, how to create connections for bamboo, and developing e-bikes with motors integrated into the bamboo. Our projects include cargo bikes for agricultural projects in Africa, bamboo structure design, developing wheelchairs using bamboo, and we worked with the UN to develop communication masks for remote communities. We’re always happy to support projects and offer our advice for free, so get in touch.

Join the Movement

If you're interested in building a bike, our advice would be to think about it or get in touch to plan it. The better the plan, the better the bike. We’ve helped thousands of people, so get in touch if you have a unique custom build or if you would like to try our easy-build lugged kits. One thing we can confidently say is it’s a unique experience and creates a new interaction every time you ride, with a common question: "Is that bamboo? Where did you get it from?" It’s always great to say, "I built it!"
Our Philosophy: Sustainable Cycling for Everyone

We believe that cycling can be more than just a mode of transportation; creating something with your own hands and then riding it offers a unique experience like no other. Building anything gives you a distinctive experience, an understanding of materials, functionality, and an appreciation for your own skills.

Bamboo Bicycle Club Help & Support

At Bamboo Bicycle Club, we’re here to support you every step of the way as you build your unique bamboo bike. Whether you're just starting your build, stuck on a particular step, or looking for advice, we've got plenty of resources and ways to connect with our community of experts and builders.
1. Help While You Build

Building a bamboo bicycle is a rewarding journey, but it can also be challenging at times. We’ve developed a range of resources to help guide you through every stage of your build. Here’s how you can get support:

  • Step-by-step guides are included with your kit.
  • Video tutorials and instructions available on our YouTube channel.
  • Direct access to experts through our Facebook group, email, and more.

No matter where you are in the process, we’re ready to assist you.
2. YouTube Channel: Over 100 Videos of Builds and Tutorials

We know that visual learning is essential when it comes to building your own bamboo bike, which is why we’ve created a comprehensive library of over 100 videos on our YouTube channel.

From complete build walkthroughs to in-depth tutorials on specific techniques, you’ll find everything you need to get your project rolling. Subscribe to our channel to receive updates on new videos and tutorials.

Visit our YouTube Channel
3. Join Our Facebook Group

Connect with the vibrant community of bamboo bike builders! Our Facebook Group is the perfect place to share progress, ask questions, and get advice from fellow builders and our team of experts.

In the group, you’ll find:

  • Support from seasoned frame builders and other community members.
  • Fast answers to your questions—post anytime and get feedback.
  • A space to share your build journey and learn from others.

Join the community today and be part of a growing movement of sustainable bike building!

Join the Facebook Group
4. Get in Touch via Email or WhatsApp

Need one-on-one support? Have a specific question about your build? We're here to help! You can reach out to us directly through email or WhatsApp for personalized assistance.

  • Email: support@bamboobicycleclub.org
  • WhatsApp: Click to chat
5. Claim Your Free 10-Minute Video Call

Sometimes a quick conversation is all it takes to get things moving again. We offer a free 10-minute video call with one of our experts to assist you with any aspect of your build. Whether you're having trouble with a particular step or want advice on customizations, our team is here to help.

Simply reach out to us via email or WhatsApp to book your video call!
